To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we design a novel regional-to-local self-attention mechanism in vision transformers to achieve a better performance.

we propose a novel architecture of vision transformer with pyramid structure that adopts the regional-to-local attention, which can achieve comparable performance to state-of-the-art vision transformers.

the regional-to-local attention can be a good alternative to the global self-attention and our proposed model achieves competitive results on various vision tasks including image classification, object detection, and instance segmentation.
In summary, our research is concerned with

how to make vision transformers more efficient and effective for computer vision tasks, and we believe our proposed regional-to-local attention will be a new building block in vision transformers in the future.

our model can achieve better performance than vanilla ViT on both image classification and object detection tasks, and it is more efficient in terms of both memory consumption and computational cost.

our model can achieve the same level of performance as vanilla ViT with a much smaller number of parameters, and it also achieves better performance than vanilla ViT with the same number of parameters.
